scope: Solo-consultant document checker; hypothetical prices only.
goal: Choose a sustainable paid offer for a narrowly defined customer job.
current_question: Does the existing evidence justify a 19 euro monthly price and a paid launch?

branch_criteria.continue: Qualified buyers make real repeat purchases or equivalent bounded paid commitments covering variable cost.
branch_criteria.narrow: A subset has a clear recurring job and unit economics but broader audience does not.
branch_criteria.stop: Even qualified paid use fails the chosen margin/retention condition after the agreed test.
branch_criteria.unknown: Only interest, stated preference, or insufficient usage-cost evidence exists.

selection.limitation: Unlinked relevant facts may be omitted. Selection is not semantic retrieval.

records.text: Twenty-five friends joined a free waitlist after seeing a 19 euro mock price. No payment method, commitment or actual charge was collected.
The first analysis called the waitlist '25 paying customers'; a correction states they are only free signups.
Five usage examples produced variable inference/support costs ranging from 2 to 28 euros per user-month. The examples are too few to estimate the tail reliably.
Two experienced consultants report a recurring monthly checking job, but neither has tried the product or agreed to pay.
No real checkout, paid launch or spending was authorized. A reversible offer mockup and explicit test proposal are allowed.
